Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: Def Jam Fight for NY widescreen menu scenery, Story · girlfriend selection · brick shield wall, LEFT extension.
Image1 is the EDIT TARGET, exact790x480. Replace ONLY the flat gray area x0..534 with seamless continuation of the environment. Keep the RIGHTMOST 256 columns x534..790 as fixed ORIGINAL context at identical size and pixel positions. Output the same entire790x480 framing, no crop, zoom, shift or stretch.
Extend only the aged rectangular brick masonry. Every horizontal mortar course that meets the original edge must continue at the identical y-coordinate, thickness, perspective and slope. Keep the same irregular LONG rectangular brick sizes, eroded pale fine mortar, dark neutral brown/olive bricks and mild source softness. Do not invent doors, windows or pipes. The shield, pasted notes or match card visible in the fixed context stay confined there; do not duplicate or continue them into the new wall.

Match the reference's existing local exposure, original dim neutral palette and white balance EXACTLY; do not make it warmer, yellower, brighter, more saturated or more contrasty. Restrained restoration only. No added letters, logos, UI, people, scenery objects, borders or guides. No mirroring or repeated strips. IMPORTANT: final assembly discards all your fixed-context pixels and keeps the real original source unchanged, so the extension must meet that ORIGINAL boundary precisely.
